info.title: Flagstaff.CLI
info.description: Command-line tool for Flagstaff, an LLM-friendly DSL that transpiles to WinUI 3 XAML: check, compile, stubs, build, run, watch, init, new view, doctor, spec.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Flagstaff: an LLM-friendly DSL (.flag) that transpiles to WinUI 3 XAML + MVVM scaffolding.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text (default) or json (one JSON document on stdout) [default: text]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress output on stderr [default: False]

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the tool version [default: False]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Parse, generate in memory and lint .flag files; writes nothing

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace used for lint checks

options.name: --stats-only
options.description: Print only the escape-ratio / generic-ratio stats (no diagnostics); the exit code still reflects errors [default: False]

arguments.name: PATHS
arguments.description: .flag files or directories (default: ./Flags if it exists, else .)

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile .flag files to XAML, code-behind and ViewModel partials (writes Generated/ and its .flagstaff-manifest.json)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory (default: ./Generated)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace (default: the project's RootNamespace, else the app name)

options.name: --styles-source
options.description: ResourceDictionary Source for the styles (default: the Flagstaff.Stdlib styles)

options.name: --clean
options.description: Delete files from the previous manifest that were not produced, even when there are errors (by default stale files are removed only on a clean compile) [default: False]

arguments.name: PATHS
arguments.description: .flag files or directories (default: ./Flags if it exists, else .)

commands.name: stubs
commands.description: Create ViewModel partials with stub implementations of the generated command delegates (On{X}Async)

options.name: --dir
options.description: Directory for the hand-written partials [default: ViewModels]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace (partials go in <ns>.ViewModels)

options.name: --update
options.description: Append missing methods to existing partials (existing members are never touched) [default: False]

arguments.name: PATHS
arguments.description: .flag files or directories (default: ./Flags if it exists, else .)

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the WinUI app with Visual Studio's MSBuild.exe (reliable XAML errors); falls back to dotnet build

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Debug or Release [default: Debug]

options.name: --platform
options.description: x64 or arm64 (default: this machine's) [default: x64]

options.name: --binlog
options.description: Write msbuild.binlog next to the project [default: False]

arguments.name: PROJECT_OR_DIR
arguments.description: A .csproj, or a directory containing exactly one (default: .)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Build (unless --no-build) and launch the app detached; prints { pid, exe }

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Debug or Release [default: Debug]

options.name: --platform
options.description: x64 or arm64 (default: this machine's) [default: x64]

options.name: --binlog
options.description: Write msbuild.binlog next to the project [default: False]

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Launch the last build without building [default: False]

arguments.name: PROJECT_OR_DIR
arguments.description: A .csproj, or a directory containing exactly one (default: .)

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Watch Flags/**/*.flag: check + compile on every change; --run also builds and relaunches

options.name: --run
options.description: Also build and (re)launch the app after each successful compile [default: False]

options.name: --once
options.description: Run a single cycle and exit (for scripts and tests) [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a runnable WinUI 3 + Flagstaff project

options.name: --output
options.description: Target directory (default: ./<AppName>)

options.name: --nav
options.description: Navigation style: side or top [default: side]

options.name: --agent
options.description: Agent instructions to add: claude, cursor or none [default: none]

arguments.name: APPNAME
arguments.description: Project and root namespace name (a C# identifier, e.g. TaskTrack)

commands.name: new
commands.description: Add items to a Flagstaff project

commands.name: view
commands.description: Add a view: Flags/<name>.flag, ViewModels/<Name>ViewModel.cs and a nav link in Flags/app.flag

options.name: --label
options.description: Nav link and heading text (default: the name in words)

options.name: --icon
options.description: Symbol icon in lowercase (default: document) [default: document]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase view name, e.g. Settings or OrderHistory (a View suffix is added)

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the build environment (.NET SDK, MSBuild.exe, WinUI XAML compiler) and the project layout

commands.name: spec
commands.description: Print the Flagstaff language reference (LANG.md) embedded in this tool

options.name: --section
options.description: Print one '##' section (case-insensitive; prefix or substring match)

options.name: --list
options.description: List the section names [default: False]
